ai_show_review.summary: Monstrous second‑set jam from He's Gone through China Doll
ai_show_review.blurb: A nonstop ~70‑minute suite stitches He’s Gone → Truckin' → The Other One → Eyes Of The World → China Doll into a high‑energy blaze. Jerry’s pristine tone and Phil’s thunder‑bass dominate, with Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones closing the set on fire.
ai_show_review.review: Feb 19 1973 at Chicago’s International Amphitheatre delivers one of the most ferocious second‑sets the Dead ever conjured. The band launches into a seamless marathon that begins with He’s Gone and rockets through Truckin’, The Other One, Eyes Of The World and finally lands on China Doll – a stretch reviewers call “a continuous, high‑energy jam sequence lasting ~70 minutes.” Jerry Garcia’s guitar is described as “perfect tone” and “emotive,” especially on the tender moments of China Doll, while Phil Lesh’s bass “kicks ass” with lead‑bass lines that many label a peak‑era moment. Bill Kreutzmann’s cymbals add shimmering crashes that punctuate the marathon without ever getting lost in the mix. The set caps off with a fiery Sugar Magnolia and a rousing Casey Jones, making this second‑set a must‑hear snapshot of ’73’s raw power. The Miller soundboard capture (gd1973-02-19.set2.sbd.miller.83023.flac16) provides crystal‑clear fidelity – “clean even at volume” – preserving every nuance of the band’s incendiary performance.

best_recording.reason: Excellent soundboard source with clean, crisp mix and no dropouts; captures the full second‑set marathon in pristine detail.

key_highlights: Seamless 70‑minute jam from He’s Gone through China Doll
Phil Lesh’s thunderous lead‑bass throughout the suite
Jerry Garcia’s perfect, emotive guitar tone especially on China Doll
High‑energy close with Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones

band_performance.Jerry: Shows a perfect, pristine guitar tone and emotive solos throughout the suite, especially on China Doll.
band_performance.Phil: Delivers thunderous, lead‑bass lines from start to finish; his solos are cited as peak‑era moments and a Leshophile highlight.
band_performance.Billy: Bill’s cymbal work adds shimmering crashes; drum foundation solid throughout the marathon jam.
